name: Luchezarnaya
source:
What secrets lie hidden in the backstreets of cities? What pain have they absorbed? And why are we so afraid of finding ourselves in unfamiliar places?

Experience wandering through the labyrinths of the urban-type settlement of “Shchaslyve,” located on the outskirts of the city, between reality and a vast industrial plant.

[Translated from [url=https://lehanfox.itch.io/luchezarnaya]itch.io[/url]]
